data.body_html:
If you’re comparing the Mangusta 80 vs Sunseeker Predator 74 for a Marbella charter in 2033, you’re looking at two of the most impressive yachts on the Costa del Sol. Both depart from Puerto Banús, carry up to 12 guests, and offer a premium experience — but they differ in layout, speed, and value. Here’s a head-to-head comparison to help you decide which one suits your day on the water.

Size and Layout

The Mangusta 80 measures 24 metres and features a spacious flybridge with sunpads, a large aft deck, and a generous bow seating area. The Sunseeker Predator 74 is slightly shorter at 22.5 metres but has a sportier, open-plan layout with a lower profile. The Mangusta’s flybridge gives you elevated views of La Concha and the Marbella coastline, while the Predator’s design emphasises sleek lines and a more intimate connection with the sea.

Performance and Speed

The Predator 74 is the faster of the two, reaching a top speed of around 35 knots compared to the Mangusta 80’s 30 knots. If you want to zip from Puerto Banús to Estepona or Sotogrande in record time, the Predator has the edge. For a more relaxed cruise with time to soak up the sun and enjoy the views, the Mangusta’s pace is more than adequate.

Charter Pricing and Inclusions

The Mangusta 80 is the more affordable option: from €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter, which includes a free jet ski. The Sunseeker Predator 74 requires a price request via WhatsApp — expect a premium price tag given its sporty reputation. Both charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%).

Which Boat Is Best for Your Group?

  • Mangusta 80 – ideal for families, groups who want more deck space, and anyone who loves the flybridge experience. The free jet ski adds a fun water activity.
  • Sunseeker Predator 74 – better for couples or small groups who prioritise speed, style, and a sportier aesthetic. It’s a head-turner in Puerto Banús.

Where Can You Go?

Both boats are perfect for exploring Marbella’s coastline. Head east to Cabopino for a swim stop, or west to Estepona and Sotogrande. The Mangusta 80’s flybridge gives you a great vantage point for spotting dolphins, while the Predator 74’s low profile allows you to get closer to coves like Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés.

Booking Your Charter

To book the Mangusta 80 at the fixed price of €4,719/4h (jet ski included), simply browse our fleet and send a WhatsApp enquiry. For the Sunseeker Predator 74, contact us via WhatsApp for a personalised quote. Both charters depart from Puerto Banús and include everything you need for a memorable day on the Mediterranean.
